159:23.en: 「Not like some pompous knight, I see.」

159:226.en: 「If I can just stop its movement!」

159:336.en: 「You dare treat me as a pawn...」

159:394.en: 「Very well. Leave this side to me.」

159:458.en: 「Hmph. Using me to clear the way?」

159:839.en: 「I have no time to play along.」

159:990.en: 「So this too is part of a miracle.」

159:1338.en: 「Damn it! Stay out of my way!」
alternatives: Damn it, stay out of my way!

159:1649.en: 「That's right. I need no way back!」

159:1690.en: 「$$ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$ commands you.」

159:1794.en: 「Reload my save? No! There's no time.」

159:1978.en: 「Now then, shall I start with you?」

159:2083.en: 「No matter how harsh the road ahead!」

159:2182.en: 「For all that I wish to protect!」

159:2394.en: 「You... You'll die by my own hand!」

159:2493.en: 「If you've truly surpassed humanity,\nthen show me you can defeat me!」

159:2546.en: 「Now... God or Demon King. Who wins?」

159:2581.en: 「You have no right\nto rule the world!」

159:2634.en: 「This world has no place for you!」

159:2937.en: 「Heh heh heh... Ha ha! As planned!」

159:3085.en: 「I fight those who prey on the weak!」

159:3190.en: 「Until I change this world, I fight!」

159:3408.en: 「You're the one with no way out!」

159:3540.en: 「Together, we can do it all... right?」

159:3622.en: 「$$カレン$$, don't quit! There's a move!」

159:3863.en: 「How dull, when all goes as I read.」

159:3945.en: 「I can tell...!\nHa ha ha ha ha ha!」

159:4190.en: 「This is enough to gauge its specs.」

159:4527.en: 「I still have a duty to fulfill...!」

159:4564.en: 「My actions led here... No, my due?!」

159:4675.en: 「Yes... I... will destroy... the world... and create... the world.........」

159:4724.en: 「I'll show you what $$ゼロ$$ can do...!」

159:4759.en: 「Those who defy the world\nwill face $$ゼロ$$...!」

159:4859.en: 「The plan is set...! Now we execute!」

159:5182.en: 「I'll knock that pride down a peg!」

159:5219.en: 「Show me how you deal with\nthis move!」

159:5369.en: 「I can't keep saying I'm bad at it!」

159:5398.en: 「I should be able to pull this off!」

159:5572.en: 「The moment you challenged me,\nthis outcome was decided.」

159:5623.en: 「You see? This is the gap in resolve.」

159:5768.en: 「$$ハマーン$$!\nPour out the emotions within you!」

159:5825.en: 「$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$!\nYou're the same as that man!」

159:5882.en: 「Who flees the past has no tomorrow!」

159:5966.en: 「I said I have no time for you!」

159:6009.en: 「$$バアル$$...!\nI'll stop you by any means!」

159:6062.en: 「$$宇宙怪獣$$...!\nI won't let you swallow the future!」

159:6172.en: 「I won't be devoured\nbefore the dialogue is complete!」

159:6227.en: 「Even if we can connect, not now!」

159:6293.en: 「Whatever it is, if you block my way!」

159:6336.en: 「Knowing their every move\nmakes this harder, but...!」

159:6432.en: 「A mere AI claiming to be a god!」

159:6559.en: 「The Demon King $$ゼロ$$ will deal\nwith the King of Darkness!」

159:6692.en: 「Even that bulk has a weak spot!」

159:6778.en: 「Sink the ship and the tide turns!」

159:6819.en: 「For one who wanted the world,\nI'll give a fitting end!」

159:6872.en: 「I'll show you\nthe struggles of the oppressed...!」

159:7003.en: 「I'm taking Earth back, $$サイデリアル$$!」

159:7044.en: 「$$サイデリアル$$!\nYour fate will run out in time!」

159:7202.en: 「Perish by your own poison,\n$$バルビエル$$!」

159:7331.en: 「Your tactics or mine... which wins?\nLet's settle it!」

159:7380.en: 「$$皇帝アウストラリス$$!\nI trust you're ready to be shot!」

159:7562.en: 「We have already killed gods\nmany times over...!」

159:7617.en: 「A judge who has lost fairness\nwill be removed from the world!」

159:7760.en: 「A traitor can expect\nthe end he deserves!」

159:7895.en: 「Whatever the reason,\nyour existence is not permitted!」

159:7991.en: 「Let's settle this, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!\nFor all futures!」

159:8052.en: 「I am $$ゼロ$$!\nThe man the people sent to fell you!」

159:8177.en: 「If resisting is humanity's history,\nI'll see it through too!」

159:8455.en: 「It's too early to exit the stage!」

159:8575.en: 「As expected, I can count on you.」

159:8697.en: 「Good work, $$ヒイロ$$. Leave it to me.」

159:8821.en: 「I won't let a single unit fall...!」

159:9019.en: 「If a Gundam goes down,\nunit morale is at stake!」

159:9099.en: 「Scatter! Take them down one by one!」

159:9134.en: 「Leave the enemy on this side to me!」

159:9392.en: 「At this rate, I win in two moves.」

159:9466.en: 「If it doesn't hit, it means nothing.」

159:9610.en: 「I read three moves ahead\nbefore I act.」

159:9692.en: 「This is the Absolute Guard Zone,\nand my power to wield it...!」

159:9778.en: 「A petty mistake. I must be careful.」

159:9979.en: 「Little by little, my calculations\nare going off...?!」

159:10108.en: 「You won't let me win that easily...!」

159:10147.en: 「Very well...!\nI'll show you a comeback from here!」

159:10241.en: 「A brush with death like this...!\nI've crossed far worse many times!」

159:10292.en: 「I still have a move...!\nAll that's left is the timing...!」

159:10347.en: 「$$ロロ$$, $$シャーリー$$, $$ユフィ$$...!\nLend me your strength!」

159:10406.en: 「For the future $$ナナリー$$ wants...!\nI will win without fail!」

159:10467.en: 「Damn it!! I didn't expect this much!」

159:10539.en: 「The game is born... from the player's actions」

159:10598.en: 「The game moves on... by the player's choices」

159:10653.en: 「Yes, this game is about to enter its next form」

159:10704.en: 「Be sure to come back. So the hands that mark time never stop...」

159:10755.en: 「This is my own way of drawing the line. I've decided to live as $$ゼロ$$」

159:10846.en: 「Even unsaid, the player surely knows what they must achieve...」

159:10919.en: 「I, $$ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$, order you!」

159:10962.en: 「Player, return to the game at once and clear SRW as fast as you can!」

159:11037.en: 「...Is what I'd like to say, but this isn't a Geass order. It's my wish.」

159:11112.en: 「I look forward to meeting you all again. Show me that miracle of yours: victory.」
